dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Huh? A new batch of goods? I'll get them moved, no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: By new batch, you refer to...

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Huh? Relax, I was referring to normal cargo.

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Munaciello keeps saying that "information is cargo too" — and he's certainly succeeded in creating all sorts of unnecessary expectations of us porters.

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Don't listen to his claptrap — we should all just do what we should.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, that's not it...

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Oh, so you're a guest here.

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Alright, then. Just call me if you need anything.

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Hello. The goods we're transporting have to pass right through here. Careful not to get hit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When you say goods...

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Supplies for disaster relief and reconstruction.

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Some are from the Snezhnayans, others from Ms. Clorinde.

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: The Boss has already given instructions. I'll take care of these, no need to bother you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Understood.

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm.

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Huh? A new shipment of goods? I'll get them moved right away.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: By new shipment, you mean...

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Huh? Relax, I meant normal goods.

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Munaciello used to keep saying that "information is a type of good too." That certainly succeeded in creating all sorts of unnecessary expectations of us porters.

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Now that we can't hear his nagging anymore... being a porter is a boring profession once again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, that's not it...

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Oh, so you're a customer.

dialogues.speaker: Kosel
dialogues.text: Alright, then. Just call me if you need anything.
